name: Liquid / blob / chrome liquid metal
look: gooey metaballs, mercury chrome, drops merging, logos condensing.

fits.notes: AI, creative, music, beauty; "fluid/adaptive" products. Needs speed: liquid on slow tempo looks screensaver

when_not: Avoid for slow tempo (reads as screensaver).

type.guidance: wide extended (Monument Extended, Neue Machina), chrome gradient
type.rule: Style type is for the world's chrome and display; the brand face always sets the real claim line and any product UI text.

colour.guidance: wide extended (Monument Extended, Neue Machina), chrome gradient; black + one hot colour.
colour.rule: Style palette fills the world; the brand colour takes the role named in brand_lock.colour_role and never drops below the contrast of the brand's own palette.

keeps: real product UI capture (composited as a screen plate, never redrawn)
brand_lock.colour_role: black plus the brand colour as the one hot colour
brand_lock.type_role: wide extended display for the logo word; brand face for the claim
brand_lock.world_changes: drops merge, the logo condenses from liquid metal
brand_lock.rule: Under a brand lock the brand colour, type and logo stay; the style world (material, picture language, motion grammar, finish, sound) is what varies between looks. A branded launch shows 3 different style worlds.

motion_grammar.note: grammars lists existing library/grammars ids; grammars_planned lists world grammars the engine plan adds (game-world, tabletop, os-desktop, type-only, editorial, collage, cinematic-world).

effects.role: chrome gradient-map on a blob mask

effects_note: rasan-fx passes (runtime/rasan-fx.js); order is the pass order. {brand_colour} / {second_ink} are filled from the brand or look palette.

codex_assets.prompt_template: equirectangular chrome studio environment map, high contrast, black and {accent} accent

animate_with.what: displacement / warp (shader fed by noise or depth)

codex_assets.r1_note: chrome/studio environment maps (equirect), reference stills for colour.
codex_assets.rules: Flat, evenly lit plain background (chroma green or pure white) for clean cut-outs; one prompt family with the same seed words; generate at 2x and downscale; never ask Codex for readable UI text or logos (typeset them in HTML).

build.recipe: `motion/other/liquid-morph.md`, `3d-cgi/liquid-metal-blob-3d.md`, `3d-cgi/raymarched-abstract-iq.md`, `systems/material/chrome-liquid-metal-cgi.md`, skill `shader-glsl`. Three.js metaballs with MarchingCubes (addons exist) or fullscreen SDF shader; env-map from a Codex-generated studio plate.

examples.title: Buck "Moshing" for Apple Music Korea (custom glitch/liquid tooling)

product_ui_rule: If the film shows RasanAI Studio, use the current dark sidebar UI with the Describe...Final dot stepper (docs/brand/studio-ui/), as a real capture composited INTO this style; never the retired light UI.

palettes.name: Mercury
palettes.words: near-black, cold white, ice periwinkle, hot magenta reflection

palettes.name: Warm chrome
palettes.words: espresso black, warm cream, amber, aqua reflection

palettes.name: Acid liquid
palettes.words: green-black, pale lime white, acid green, violet

brand_lock.rule: Brand colour is the single environment-light reflected into the chrome (one coloured gel); the metal itself and the black stay style-fixed. Slots marked brand take the brand colour (exact hex); slots marked style keep the palette value; brand-or-style takes the brand colour only when its contrast against the other slot is at least 4.5:1, else the palette value.

scale.note: cqw = 1% of the frame width (1080p: 1cqw = 19.2 px)

pairings.note: Wide extended display with a vertical chrome gradient fill (white to grey to black to white).

scale.note: cqw = 1% of the frame width (1080p: 1cqw = 19.2 px)

type.load: In a HyperFrames composition add the two <link> tags from `google` to <head> (plus rel=preconnect to fonts.googleapis.com and fonts.gstatic.com), set font-family from `css`, and wait for document.fonts.ready before the first screenshot / timeline build. Offline renders: download the families once (they are OFL) into the project's fonts/ folder and use @font-face. The brand face always sets the real claim line and the product UI text; the style pairing is for the world's chrome and display.
type.rule: Style type is for the world's chrome and display; the brand face always sets the real claim line and any product UI text. Under a brand lock keep the brand face for the claim and use the pairing's display for labels only.

finish.how: Runtime: RasanFX.create({ source, passes: [...] }) from runtime/rasan-fx.js, applied in the listed order, on the whole composition canvas or on the Codex plate only (plate-only when the type must stay crisp). `css` lists the cheap approximation kinds story boards and style frames draw with plain CSS (grain:<opacity>, scan:<opacity>, halftone, pixel, led-dots ...).

composition.grid: single hero blob centred or on a third on a near-black void; slow low-frequency motion
composition.safe_area: 12% margin; hero 55% of frame height; type below or above on a long baseline
composition.product_ui: UI sits on a floating dark glass plane that the chrome reflects; the UI itself stays flat and crisp

codex.template: {subject} {action}, {setting}. Camera and lens: 100 mm macro, f/8, slightly low angle, no distortion. Lighting: a studio HDRI of black with two large white strip lights and one coloured gel strip. Material: polished liquid mercury chrome, mirror reflections, rippling surface tension, thin black and white banding in reflections. Colour, locked to the palette {palette_words}, and nothing outside it. Texture and finish: smooth, perfectly clean mirror; no scratches. Avoid: no text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no matte surfaces, no plastic, no soft pastel, no visible seams, no text, no cheesy bubble highlights.
codex.camera: 100 mm macro, f/8, slightly low angle, no distortion
codex.lighting: a studio HDRI of black with two large white strip lights and one coloured gel strip
codex.material: polished liquid mercury chrome, mirror reflections, rippling surface tension, thin black and white banding in reflections
codex.colour_rule: Name the palette's colours in words (the palette's `words`), never hex codes; add 'and nothing outside this palette'. Pick one palette per film and keep it.
codex.texture: smooth, perfectly clean mirror; no scratches

aspect.note: Plates: ask for about 12% bleed around the frame so the camera can travel; keep the calm side empty for type. Generate 16:9 for the frame, 1:1 for sprite sheets and objects.

consistency.anchor: Make the anchor plate first, approve it by eye, then pass it as --ref to every other image (imagegen batch does this with --world).
consistency.style_line: Append the world bible's style line (30-45 words, no hex) to every prompt.
consistency.seed_words: Keep these words verbatim in every prompt of the film: polished liquid mercury chrome; 100 mm macro; near-black, cold white, ice periwinkle, hot magenta reflection.

sprite_sheet.rules: Not a sprite style. For a cut-out object or character use --transparent (flat #00FF00 key, then despill); one subject, no shadow plane.
